name: Slingshot
summary: A send control you drag back like a slingshot; let go and your note flies into a target inbox
about: A playful send control under an open sky. Your note drops into a yellow pebble held by a rubber band on a wooden fork. Drag it back and the band stretches thinner while a power reading climbs, let go and the band snaps and wobbles while the pebble whips through, arcs away with a trail and smacks into the target. The board wobbles, a ripple and a pinned note mark the spot, a Delivered flag pops and a fresh pebble drops in. It suits feedback boxes, thank-you notes, kudos walls and fun contact forms.
how: Write a note in the card (or keep the sample). An empty card shakes when you try to send.
Drag the pebble back and down: the note slips into it, the band stretches and the hint shows the power.
Let go: the band snaps back on a spring while the pebble flies along an arc with a dotted trail. A short pull just springs back.
Tap the pebble or press Enter or Space and the slingshot pulls itself back and fires for you.
The target wobbles, a ripple and a pinned note appear, the counter goes up, Delivered pops and a new pebble drops into the band.
